title: Personal KPI weekly check-in - Arya Singh - 2026-03-17
content:
WEEKLY CHECK-IN (notes / scratchpad) - March 15-17, 2026

Context / top objectives for quarter:
- Q1 goal: reduce median text-generation latency for 8k-context models by 15% on dedicated tier while keeping unit cost within +/-5% of baseline.
- Personal OKR (eng-serving-runtime): lead perf tuning for attention kernel selection + own rollout plan for model-variant routing policy.

This week's focus (what I actually worked on):
- Kernel selector prototype: landed heuristic to prefer fused-attn path for small-batch low-latency traffic. Perf numbers look promising on p4 (local perf tests).
  - Quick numbers: median p99 token latency down ~9% on test harness; tail still rough for cold KV-cache.
- Canary rollout plan doc (draft): started outline, need to add metrics and automatic rollback thresholds.
- Paired w/ Samira on e2e reproducibility tests for batching settings. Found flaky test due to timestamped fixtures — added TODO to sanitize.
- Responded to ops alert on dedicated pool saturation (spike last Wed). Root cause appears to be misconfigured autoscaler threshold; raised Jira ticket (JIRA-3241).

Measurements / KPIs (personal tracking):
- Perf uplift work: target +15% median; current measured uplift toward target: ~9% (progress 60%).
- Unit cost impact: estimated +1.5% (within allowed band). Need more full-load runs to confirm.
- PR throughput: 3 PRs merged related to perf and tests this week.

Blocked / risks / open questions:
- KV-cache cold-start tail still high; might need a short-lived pre-warming strategy for canary traffic. Researching options (prefetch vs small warmup bursts).
- Need better tracing for kernel selection path to correlate kernel choice -> latency per request. Logged issue to add trace ids in selection module.
- Dependence on infra to repro full-load behavior on dedicated cluster — queued on infra to provision a test pool (ticket created, ETA 3/22).

Actions / next week plan (concrete):
1) Add tracing hooks to kernel selector (instrumentation): small PR, aim to open Mon 3/16, merge by Wed 3/18.
2) Finish canary rollout doc: add metrics, define rollback conditions (p95 latency increase >3% for >10 min OR error rate >0.5%), share w/ SRE and product. Target review Thu 3/19.
3) Run full-load perf jobs once infra pool is available, collect cost delta and tail metrics. If tail persists, prototype warmup bursts.
4) Follow up with Samira on flaky tests and cleanup timestamp fixtures.

Retro / notes to self (informal):
- Good momentum on kernel heuristics — avoid over-optimizing for one hardware class; need matrix of hw x sequence-length.
- Stop adding too many TODOs in code without tickets — created more friction in review.
- Pairing sessions with Samira = high ROI, keep scheduling 1x/week for 60m.

Misc scratch items (quick links / reminders):
- Revisit quantization guidance from Optimize team; might interact with kernel choice for INT8 paths.
- Follow-up with infra: ask for a small, isolated dedicated pool so we can run controlled tests (refer to ticket: JIRA-3241).
- Draft canary doc link (WIP): github.com/redwood-inference/docs/canary-rollouts (local draft in repo).

Notes for manager 1:1:
- Progress good but dependent on infra provisioning to validate final numbers.
- Asking for 1 week of dedicated infra time (or bump priority) to avoid slipping quarter target.

End of notes.

-- Arya
